explanation: The insurgency’s article dates it to the end of the war: “The conflict started immediately following the fall of Kabul in August 2021, and the insurgency represents the continuation of the decades-long Afghan conflict”, waged “by armed factions loyal to the defunct Islamic Republic of Afghanistan against the Taliban-led Islamic Emirate”. The fall of Kabul on 15 August 2021 is where this atlas ends `war-in-afghanistan-2001-2021`; both records are filed inside `afghan-conflict`, which the same sentence names.
